components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default answer of a permission request.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: #b5552f; color: #fff; font: 600 13px Vazirmatn, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #a14a28; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d97757; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 28px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid #ffffff1a; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: #ccc; font: 13px Vazirmatn, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #2b2b2b; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #d97757; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Composer
components.description: The prompt box with its bar of chips.
components.css: .ds-composer { border: 1px solid #454545; border-radius: 8px; background: #313131; padding: 8px; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: #d97757; } .ds-composer-input { width: 100%; border: 0; background: none; color: #ccc; font: 14px/1.9 Vazirmatn, sans-serif; resize: none; outline: none; } .ds-composer-input::placeholder { color: #989898; } .ds-composer-bar { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-chip { height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(204 204 204 / .1); color: #ccc; font: 13px Vazirmatn, sans-serif; } .ds-chip:hover { background: rgb(204 204 204 / .18); } .ds-send { width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #c6613f; color: #fff; }

narrative.overview: A tidy desk in a dim room. Everything has a place and stays in it; the surface is grey and still, and the one warm colour on it — Claude orange — appears only where something needs the person. The window is a Persian, right-to-left reading of the Claude Code VS Code extension's webview.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only, flat tonal layers, hairline borders, almost no shadow.
One accent, used sparingly: Claude orange.
Every size comes from one scale; persian-claude-gui/test_scale.py fails on anything else.
Persian body text is generous (14px, line height 1.9); chrome is 13px.
Paths, code and numbers are always isolated LTR inside RTL text.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Orange marks what needs the person or what they are acting on. If a screen has orange on something that needs nothing, remove it.

rules.name: The No Blue Rule
rules.body: No blue accent anywhere — not for focus, links, selection, badges or the pending state. Categorical chart colours in the usage panel are the only exception.

rules.name: The Twelve Floor Rule
rules.body: No Persian text below 12px; Vazirmatn is unreadable there. 11px is for Latin digits and mono only.

rules.name: The Six Steps Rule
rules.body: Font sizes are 11, 12, 13, 14, 16, 20 — nothing else, and never em that compounds. Weights are 400, 500 and 700 — the three vendored Vazirmatn files; 600 renders as 700.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the transcript casts a shadow.

dos: Do take every size from the scale: spacing 2/4/8/12/16/24/32 (+20 gutter), type 11/12/13/14/16/20, corners 4/6/8/full, controls 24/28/32, icons 14/16.
Do run test_scale.py, audit_ui.py and the layout gates in both editions before calling a visual change done.
Do give every path, command, number and code span its own LTR isolate (spec rules 1–7).
Do keep tokens.css byte-identical in both editions.
donts: Don't use a blue accent, a light theme, or a gradient.
Don't set Persian text below 12px or use em font sizes that compound.
Don't let a hover element cover content; reserve its room.
Don't put orange on anything that does not need the person.
Don't add a shadow to anything inside the transcript.
